changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: alter table donation drop constraint ck_donation_symbol_claim_pairing
alter table donation drop constraint ck_donation_confirmed_symbol_link
alter table donation add constraint ck_donation_symbol_claim_pairing check (symbol_claim_id is null or coalesce(paired_by, '') = 'CONFIRMED_SYMBOL')
alter table donation add constraint ck_donation_confirmed_symbol_sources check (coalesce(paired_by, '') <> 'CONFIRMED_SYMBOL' or (sender_account_id is null) = (symbol_claim_id is null))
